blurb: The Johnson Center for Community Arts and Education is a venue created to facilitate community access to visual and performing arts and education through partnerships and collaboration. The Johnson Center provides access to safe, reliable, and appropriately equipped small-scale rehearsal, production, and performance spaces for members of the Iron County arts community.
